purpose: Runs the real set-up, lay-down, runner and health check against fresh and conflicting Claude Code configurations (top level, per model, environment, command line, managed settings), reads what reaches the session, checks that the health check reports drift, and that it says it cannot confirm the window when a source cannot be read.
title: Installer sets and the health check guards the auto-compact window

testCases.description: core's settings carry an auto-compact window of 500000 tokens, and lay-down lays the same settings into Squire's config folder
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/compaction-window.test.js::core's settings carry an auto-compact window of 500000 tokens, and lay-down lays the same settings into Squire's config folder

testCases.description: the window reaches Squire's session only from its config folder: the owner's own settings, a window variable around the runner and a stray --autocompact never reach it
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/compaction-window.test.js::the window reaches Squire's session only from its config folder: the owner's own settings, a window variable around the runner and a stray --autocompact never reach it

testCases.description: the health check names a window other than 500000 in Squire's config folder, at the top level and per model, and in the runner's environment
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/compaction-window.test.js::the health check names a window other than 500000 in Squire's config folder, at the top level and per model, and in the runner's environment

testCases.description: the health check names a window other than 500000 in the Mac's managed settings file, its drop-in folder and the managed preferences

testCases.description: a model that runs below 500k is not drift for a window at or above its own, while the same window for a 1M model is named
